user: What happens if I miss a dose of PrEP, and how will it affect my protection against HIV?
bot:
It's important to take PrEP as directed. 

If you miss a dose of oral PrEP (Truvada), take it as soon as you remember. 

If it's almost time for the next dose, skip the missed one. Never take two doses at once.

For injectable PrEP (Apretude or Yeztugo), missing a dose means you may need to reschedule your appointment. 

Both oral and injectable PrEP are up to 99% effective to prevent HIV infection when taken as directed. 

Missing doses can lower this effectiveness. Talk to your healthcare provider if you miss doses often.
